affected_predicate.description: All bookmarked posts bearing the #pets tag are removed from the account's Bookmarks list.

competing_trace_defects.description: A mis-targeted interaction opened the New post composer, followed by additional back/navigation actions before returning to the saved feed; this visibly diverted from bookmark removal before the reuse target.

chains.rationale: At step 23, the reused back-navigation plan was applied while the Saved feed was already visible, and the resulting screen was the device home screen. The subsequent reopen and navigation back to Bookmarks visibly corrected that detour; the last observed Bookmarks screen is empty before Finished.

summary: The reused step-23 back action visibly exited Mastodon from the Saved feed, but the trajectory subsequently returned to Bookmarks and visibly showed an empty list.
